request_schema.description: The `configuration::on-updated` event, delivered to the internal `session::on-config-change` handler as output. The handler re-fetches the authoritative configuration, so it reads only the (advisory) configuration id; a struct (not `Value`) keeps the request schema concrete and unknown fields are ignored.

id.description: Configuration id that changed (advisory; the handler re-fetches the value).

request_schema.title: OnConfigChangeEvent

response_schema.description: Ack returned by the internal `session::on-config-change` handler.
response_schema.title: OnConfigChangeResponse
